reason: The physical LCD status was a 5x8 bitmap scaled from 192 to 320 pixels by 5/3; nonuniform stroke widths and letter spacing reduced legibility.
changes: Draw the three LCD status fields with the native interface font at 1:1 pixels (Ark Pixel 16 for the default UI family).
Center text within three 96-pixel fields at x8,112,216; draw separators as one-pixel lines at y63.
Keep the numerical calculator font, compact USB frame and clock position in the top header.

host_tests.regression_before_fix: native_status pixel comparison fails on the former 5/3-scaled 5x8 LCD text
coverage: Every LCD status pixel compared with the native ui_font glyph atlas independently of the compact calculator face
Blank pixel columns separate adjacent glyph ink; RU/EN and RETURN fit their fields
RU/EN AUTO/RUN/PRG modes, angle units and last-key labels
Exact numeric raster retained for both calculator fonts
All 50x14 header clock pixels, no duplicate clock below status; input/RUN/PRG hide it
